name: Theme library and custom XP theme installer
description: XPlasma Plus Properties with stock themes and Install Theme… for XP archives, .theme and .msstyles files.

name: XP window borders and desktop colors
description: Luna borders, titlebars and XP colors; includes the maximized-titlebar corrections.

name: XP application controls
description: Qt and GTK controls, including generated Flatpak themes and the generalized LibreOffice/layout fix.

name: Windows XP fonts
description: Tahoma, Trebuchet MS, Lucida Console and the XP font-rendering preferences.

name: Start menu, taskbar and system tray
description: XP Start menu without corner background/grips, labeled task buttons, tray and clock.

name: XP system and application icons
description: Original XP icons plus 7,390 named replacements covering the installed KDE/Breeze inventory, mask-safe controls and XP-styled specialized glyphs. Credits and source licenses are included; replacements survive theme changes.

name: XP mouse pointers
description: Windows Default pointers with shadows and multiple sizes for sharp, correctly sized cursors.

name: Windows XP sounds
description: Original Windows Default event sounds.

name: Bliss wallpaper
description: Applies the original Bliss wallpaper. Extra wallpapers and stock styles are included with the theme library.

name: XP-style window and alert behavior
description: Removes flying alerts and adds the transparent checkered snapping outline. Window snapping remains enabled.

name: XP minimize and maximize animation
description: Builds the classic caption animation for this computer (Plasma 6.6–6.8). Log out/in after installation. Credits aubymori.

name: Windows XP user account pictures
description: Adds the 24 original XP portraits to System Settings → Users → Change avatar. Keeps your current picture.

name: Default XP desktop shortcuts
description: My Computer, My Documents, My Network Places, Internet Explorer and Recycle Bin.

name: XP logout and shutdown menus
description: Original XP dialogs, automatically retained when you change themes.

name: XP Welcome desktop splash
description: XP-style Welcome screen while Plasma starts, separate from login and boot screens.

name: XP lock screen
description: An XP-style password screen using Plasma's existing authentication.

name: XP Welcome login screen
description: SDDM theme and login pointers. Applies on the next login; does not log you out.

name: XP boot splash
description: Original XP boot artwork and loading animation; rebuilds the initramfs.

name: IE6 Replica — Firefox ESR
description: Separate browser/profile, XP tabs and icons, Search/Go/New Tab buttons, genuine XP flag, and links opening in tabs.

name: Use IE6 Firefox as the default web browser
description: Requires IE6 Replica. Opens web links and pages in it, and makes it KDE's preferred browser; Remove returns the previous choices.
